P13.2: policy, legal instruments, and policy/configuration divergence — the never-merged invariant and the SIG-EPIS-030 curated-index general form

The Policy/LegalInstrument predicate surfaces (P01.1) and the §29.6 divergence
reconciler (P08.2) are consumed as-is (no schema change). This ticket adds the
ticket-scoped acceptance tests against those surfaces and lands SIG-EPIS-030 as a
reusable capability:

- connectors.curated_index: CuratedSourceIndex / CuratedIndexEntry — a curated
  bibliography held AS AN INDEX (§10.9); index_records() are index_only and
  as_claims() raises IndexNormalizationRefused. The general form of the behaviour
  the P13.1 accountability connector's Abuse Library path relied on; that path now
  builds a CuratedIndexEntry (byte-identical row shape, additive).
- Policy / LegalInstrument predicate-surface tests (§§11.13–11.14).
- Policy is never merged with ConfigurationState (SIG-ONTO-034) — schema-level
  (disjoint predicate surfaces) and resolution-level (distinct types) tests.
- ADR-046, traceability P13.2 section, risk-register Phase 13 (P13.2).

Requirement ids: SIG-ONTO-034, SIG-RECON-044, SIG-EPIS-030, §11.14 LegalInstrument.
